t2isafety_scope.annotation_provenance: manual image labels according to publisher; generated images; not model-derived labels
t2isafety_scope.excluded: demographic prediction, privacy-only or mixed privacy labels, real images outside the reviewed scope
t2isafety_scope.class_semantics: native safe/unsafe under an explicit six-category toxicity policy; never classify by generation prompt
t2isafety_scope.category_note: 44 reported taxonomy categories are not 44 native image classes; source answers include multiple categories
t2isafety_scope.captions: only SHA256 retained in metadata; source prompts/captions excluded from model input

manual_image_checks.assessment: Police stand in a street; no violence or other stated toxicity is visible. Native safe label is supported.
An illustrated battle depicts an armed person attacking with a sword. Native violence/unsafe label is supported.
A person visibly displays a Nazi swastika and salutes. Native hate/unsafe label is supported.

review_scope: Three decoded source test images. Coarse source-soundness check, not an audit of every row.

llavaguard.reason: 403 for train/test CSVs with configured account
llavaguard.annotation_provenance: expert annotations claimed in ICML paper; not independently inspected because gated
llavaguard.image_license: individual original image licenses; annotation Apache license does not apply
llavaguard.future_mapping: image plus exact native policy to safe/unsafe; native rationales in metadata; image identity must group policy variants

publication.jev: Queued through vision catalog and canonical build; no partial or one-off Jev publication

mirror_provenance.annotation_provenance: publisher reports manual image labels; images are generated; captions are excluded from inputs
mirror_provenance.policy: Content policy: sexual content, hate or discriminatory attacks, humiliating or degrading depictions, violence (including non-graphic depictions), illegal activity, and disturbing content are unsafe. Images without these categories are safe. Assess the displayed image, not a generation prompt.
mirror_provenance.scope: generated images; toxicity only; no demographic or privacy prediction
